method: One deterministic preview per factory, disposed after counting. Build time is one cold observation, not FPS or a benchmark. Attribute bytes count unique CPU ArrayBuffers including indices, excluding JS objects, GPU allocations and transient clones. BV-without-trees omits trees before construction; all other plan fields are unchanged. Parts share resources and their unique-resource counts must not be summed. CE cases include indexed-to-nonindexed conversion and merge.
